connector.name: Kalshi Prediction Markets
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Kalshi prediction markets: native RSA-PSS auth, rate limiting, demo/prod safety.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package kalshi-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cejor6 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KALSHI_API_KEY_ID
env.description: Kalshi API key ID from https://kalshi.com/account/profile

env.name: KALSHI_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
env.description: Filesystem path to the RSA private key PEM. Set this or KALSHI_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM.

env.name: KALSHI_PRIVATE_KEY_PEM
env.description: Inline PEM contents, for hosted deploys without filesystem access.

env.name: KALSHI_ENV
env.description: demo or prod. Defaults to demo for safety.

env.name: KALSHI_ALLOW_PROD
env.description: Must be 1 for the server to start with KALSHI_ENV=prod. Defaults to 0.

env.name: KALSHI_TRADING_ENABLED
env.description: Must be 1 for order-placement tools to operate. Read-only by default (0).
